ModMetaData.name: Startup Log Compatibility Fixes
ModMetaData.author: Local compatibility patch
ModMetaData.description: Fixes startup, save-loading, caravan, world-object, and quest-chain compatibility errors from Medieval Tailor Continued, [OA] Ratkin: Knight Order (Furniture), Map Mode Framework with ReGrowth 2, Vehicle Framework, Vanilla Animals Expanded, Useful Marks Settings Save, Medieval Kingdoms, VFE Medieval, and Hospitality. Invalid quest targets and overlapping merchant-guild sites are skipped safely; existing broken quests are ended without penalties. Medieval players do not receive non-RimDark above-medieval item requests or rewards.
